{'text': '蘋果（Apple）今日推出了一段趣味十足的廣告，宣傳配備 M6 晶片的新款 Mac mini。公司隨後亦發布了一段簡短的幕後花絮影片，展示了製作這段廣告所涉及的（大量）製作過程。請看以下影片。', 'source': '[0] Apple today rolled out a fun ad for the new M6-equipped Mac mini. The company has also now shared a brief behind-the-scenes video showing the (massive) production that went into making this ad. Check out the video below.'}

{'text': '「所有東西都要靠雙手雕刻和製作」', 'source': '[1] “Everything had to be carved and crafted by hand”'}

{'text': '蘋果的 @helloapple Instagram 帳號今日發布了一段簡短的 Instagram Reels 短片，展示了這條為配備 M6 晶片的新 Mac mini 拍攝的趣味廣告背後的製作過程。', 'source': '[2] Apple’s @helloapple Instagram account today posted a short Instagram Reel showcasing the making of this fun ad for the new M6-equipped Mac mini.'}

{'text': '影片中（經 MacMagazine 報導），動畫師 Justin Rasch 和 Scott DaRos，以及美術總監 Josh Mahan，展示了他們在製作過程中所使用的草圖、道具、雕塑、技術和材料，還有停格動畫的縮時影片和幕後片段，揭示了廣告中多個動畫效果的製作方式。', 'source': '[3] In the video (via MacMagazine), animators Justin Rasch and Scott DaRos, along with art director Josh Mahan, show off the sketches, props, sculpts, techniques, and materials used in production, as well as stop-motion time-lapses and behind-the-scenes footage, revealing how multiple animations in the ad were made.'}

{'text': '雖然這條廣告不如蘋果為入門級手提電腦 MacBook Neo 推出的 TikTok 宣傳活動那樣瘋狂奔放，但同樣趣味十足，當你看到當中投入的大量實景製作功夫後，更會覺得別具一番趣味。', 'source': '[4] While the ad isn’t as wildly over-the-top as the TikTok promotional campaign Apple put together for the entry-level MacBook Neo, it’s still plenty fun, and all the more so when you see the sheer amount of practical production that went into it.'}
